# src/scene

**Owned by the separate Three.js build. Do not edit this folder from other
work.**

This directory is reserved for the WebGL scene build and its supporting code.
Changes here belong to that build, not to general app work.

## Rules

- Do not create, modify, move or delete anything in this folder unless the task
  explicitly says to work on the scene build.
- Do not import from this folder outside the scene build.
- If app-side work appears to need a change here, stop and raise it instead.

See `AGENTS.md` at the repository root.
